characteristics.description: This unit's melee attacks can re-roll hit rolls.

At the start of your Command phase, if this unit contains one or more Cenobyte Servitor models, select up to one of the abilities in the Temple Relics section. Until the start of your next Command phase, this model has that ability.


Banner of the Emperor Victorious
This unit has +1 to advance rolls and charge rolls.


Column from the Major Altar
This unit has +1 T.


Water from the Stoup of Elucidation
This unit's melee attacks have +1 AP.

This unit can be attached to the following units:

■ Assault Intercessor Squad
■ Infernus Squad
■ Intercessor Squad
■ Crusader Squad
■ Sword Brethren

- If this unit’s Chaplain Grimaldus model is destroyed, this unit’s remaining Cenobyte Servitor models are also destroyed.
- Each Cenobyte Servitor model in this unit takes up 0 transport capacity.

This unit's melee attacks have:
- +1 A.
- +1 S.

At the start of the Fight phase, select up to one enemy unit engaged with this unit and roll one D6:


- On a 2-3, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
- On a 4-5, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.
- On a 6+, that enemy unit suffers D3+3 mortal wounds.

This model can be attached to the following units:
ASSAULT INTERCESSOR SQUAD, BLADEGUARD VETERAN SQUAD, COMPANY HEROES, CRUSADER SQUAD, INTERCESSOR SQUAD, SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD
In your opponent's Shooting phase, each time an enemy unit has shot, if any models in this unit were destroyed as a result of those attacks, this unit can make a surge move of up to D6+1.
In your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit that was engaged with this unit ends a fall-back move, if this unit is unengaged it can make a normal move of up to 6".
Attacks allocated to this model have ‑1 D.
This unit has +1 to charge rolls.

This model can be attached to the following units:
ASSAULT INTERCESSOR SQUAD, CRUSADER SQUAD, INTERCESSOR SQUAD, STERNGUARD VETERAN SQUAD, SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD
You cannot include more than one **^^Emperor's Champion^^** unit in your army.

This unit’s ranged attacks that target a Monster/Vehicle unit can:


- Re-roll one hit roll.
- Re-roll one wound roll.
- Re-roll one damage roll.
This unit’s ranged attacks that target a unit (excluding Monster/Vehicle units) have +1 AP.
This unit’s ranged attacks that target a unit within 12" of this unit have +1 S.

characteristics.capacity: This model has a transport capacity of 7 Adeptus Astartes Infantry models. It cannot transport Terminator or Jump Pack models. Each Gravis model takes up the space of 2 models.

characteristics.description: In your Movement phase, when this unit ends an advance move, units embarked within this unit can make a shock disembark move.

characteristics.capacity: This model has a transport capacity of 14 Adeptus Astartes Infantry models. Each Terminator, Gravis, Jump Pack, Wulfen model takes up the space of 2 models.

characteristics.description: In your opponent’s Charge phase, when an enemy unit has selected charge targets, you can select one friendly unengaged **Adeptus Astartes** unit that was one of those charge targets and is eligible to embark within this transport. If every model in that unit is within 3" of this transport, that unit can embark within this transport. That enemy unit can then select new charge targets for that charge move.
